Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: From the PFT studio in marginally attractive downtown Danville, animated live in front of a studio audience, it's the Phineas and Ferb Musical Cliptastic Countdown! And now, our hosts, from opposite ends of the moral, ethical and philosophical spectrum, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz and Major Francis Monogram!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello Danville!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, we're taking a break from our usual hostili—you know, I've gotta go back one. Your first name is Francis?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes. Spelled with an i.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Spelled with an i? Wouldn't that be "Frinces?"

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, F-R-A-N-C-I-S. It's the masculine spelling.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Francis?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes. Anyway, we're not here to discuss my name. We're here because kids all over the world logged on to vote for their favorite Phineas and Ferb music videos. And we're countin' 'em down! Starting with number 10. Are ya ready, Dr. D?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fran, Francis, Franny. Yes, very macho.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ugh now see, this is why I just go by "Major".

Name: Crash
Dialog: Ladies and Gentlemen, Candace and her best friend, Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What do you think your brothers are doing right now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who cares?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, how'd you like that one D-man?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Too loud. Kids today with their rock and their roll.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, here's a deaf jam that's really kicking it old school.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know that whole street lingo thing? Y-You can't really pull that off.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ugh, roll number nine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just telling you as a friend!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it; you're getting it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoo-hoo! Follow that music, Ferb.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm standing here with Cindy, an animated member of our studio audience who-

Name: Irving
Dialog: (pushes Cindy aside) Phineas and Ferb rock! Wooooo! (**Cindy:** Hey!)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay then, let's throw it over to my partner in crime. Not that I'd actually perpetrate a crime with him of course, I-I would never... (at Carl) Carl! Who wrote these cue cards?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent M, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What, what is that all about? I mean he's using a typewriter. When was the last time you saw someone using a typewriter? Wha-What is this, 1987?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You realize most of the kids watching this show have never even seen a typewriter, right?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We're on a budget.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh so you went to an antique store...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Moving on. Number eight; roll tape!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, so you got tape, you're not just using film, or-or-or hand shadows...

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ssh!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ugh! Would you just go join the band?

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Hey, I got rhythm!

Name: Doofenshmitz
Dialog: Okay, anyway, I knew I couldn't appear on the Cliptastic Countdown empty-handed, so I brought a little something for all of us to enjoy! Behold, the Music Video Clip-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, when I was a small boy, my parents would never let me watch music videos...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No no! We don't have time for an emotionally scarring back-story.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, maybe I should give you an emotionally scarring front-story!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, that doesn't even make any sense.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It doesn't have to, I got a monster truck! Wooohooo!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Video number-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Number 7!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (wincing in pain) That was my foot!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice song, sis.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Ding)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hehehe, what Francis doesn't realize is that this is more than a Music Video Clip-inator, it's a Music Video Mind-Control-inator! AHAHAHAHAHAHA- (Notices crowd, maniacal music stops abruptly) Oh...Hi, um, ahem, I mean uh- I was- I was just saying... Mimes control my gator! See, look over there! (Pan out to see two mimes performing in front of two alligators) And you thought I was making it up! Now, onto video number 6!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace. Have you been near the wild parsnips again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deep-voiced) Yes, but you gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it now?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Testify, Candace, testify!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Let me spell it out for you, Mom:

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Everybody!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's what I'm talking about!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That was stupid fresh!! I'm making that one my ringtone for sure! And right now, I've got a surprise for all who have youngsters, a special guest who's got his own death theme song.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's right, it's P to the P, P-squared, or as I like to call him, Agent P!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: He's doing a special appearance on a music video clip show.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Well, good for him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, Agent P, I think everyone would like to know, what are your thoughts on the videos we've seen tonight?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, thanks for coming.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And I think that sets up our next music video perfectly. Here it is thanks to your votes, video number 5!

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: Now somebody, anybody, everybody, scream!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (off screen) Ahhh!! (jumps onscreen) There are squirrels in my pants!

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: That girl's got some serious squirrels in her pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There are squirrels in my pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels in my pants!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't go away, folks. When we come back, we'll have the final four. (He pauses and holds up three fingers. He realizes his mistake and holds up four. The crowd laughs) Plus, a special video that will ENSLAVE THE TRI-STATE AREA!! HAHAHA... I-I mean uh... engrave my pie-plate carrier! (pauses and picks up pie plate carrier) Look, it's silver! It was a wedding gift. I got it in the divorce! That's right ladies, I'm available!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, you're-you're getting paid for this? I'm doing this as community service! I-I gotta do like, 200 hours!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This show is only half an hour long.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have to do this 400 times?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, and we're back. We're counting down the top 10 Phineas and Ferb music videos from Season 1, as picked by you, the viewers.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you are definitely buying lunch.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, here's a little number I like to call four.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I kind of miss the little guys. It's as if there was a whole other side to our relationship that I never noticed before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Stace, you're kind of bumming me out with the song there.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Tubular. If I had been wearing socks, they would've been rocked right off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're really not wearing socks?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, but not at the moment. (To Carl) Carl, how are my socks coming?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Almost done, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, here's video number 3.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Fantastical. (To Doofenshmirtz) Say, Doofenshmirtz, what'cha working on over here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Your doom. (drops a cage on Monogram)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly-moogly. (at Carl) Carl, get me Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) He's in the green room, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that should be easy then. Please enjoy music video number 2.

Name: Dancer
Dialog: All hail Queen Wahini!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe it!

Name: Singers
Dialog: Say!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: "Brother, whatcha gonna do today?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughing maniacally) Now my ultimate triumph is at hand! Prepare to be hypnotized by a video scientifically created to get stuck in your heads, forever!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Noooooo!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Avert your ears, Agent P! Cover your ears!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, no, oh, get back in there! Wait why isn't..? What? Perry the Platypus? I swear, of all the aquatic mammals I hang with, you are truly the most uncooperative! (As Doof is saying this the dang DVD just goes in and out and in and out because of Doof and Perry's insistent button pushing)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's working! It's working!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh no, Agent P! It's stuck in their heads! We need something even more catchy to counteract it! But what could we...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P, this is no time for decorating-- (looks at monitor) Ooh, I see.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Not the number one requested Phineas and Ferb song! New extended version, never before seen. Not that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, the Ferbettes! I'm Phineas and this is Ferb, and we're gonna sing a song.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great job, Agent P. You stopped Doofenshmirtz, saved the Tri-State Area, and finished the music video countdown. (at the camera) Well, thanks for tuning in, folks. We'll see ya next time. (at Doofenshmirtz, who is now trapped in the cage) Say good night, Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, someday I'll get out of this cage, but your name will still be Francis.
